title: Rolling metric ring summary
description: Source: src/box/metrics.ts Ring.summary(). NULL until the ring has a sample: summary() returns null while filled === 0, so a consumer must treat null as 'not measured yet' and never as zero — a p95 of null is an absence, and rendering it as 0 would invent a measurement. Every percentile is independently nullable. OPEN like the rest of this contract: `required` already catches a dropped or renamed percentile, which is the drift that breaks a consumer, whereas an ADDED percentile breaks nobody — so adding one must not need a contract bump.
